# GitHub Copilot instructions

Canonical instructions for this repository live in [`.ai/AGENTS.md`](../.ai/AGENTS.md).
Read that file before generating or reviewing code here - in particular the
layer boundaries in [`docs/architecture/DEPENDENCY_RULES.md`](../docs/architecture/DEPENDENCY_RULES.md)
and the coding standards in [`docs/architecture/CODING_STANDARDS.md`](../docs/architecture/CODING_STANDARDS.md).

This file is intentionally a pointer, not a duplicate rule set - see
[ADR-0005](../docs/adr/ADR-0005-ai-single-source-of-truth.md).
